# What our customers say about us

> _The most important reason that we use Forwood’s CRM solution is that is gives us a fatality prevention program. We don’t want fatalities in Metso. It is a proven way of preventing fatalities and ensuring critical controls are in place. We’ve had injuries and incidents in the near past where critical control checks were not done. Had they been done, that injury probably wouldn’t have occurred. We have enough procedures, and that’s great! We have a safety management system, and that’s great! We did not have a frontline check that ensures those critical controls are in place. This program does that. Secondly, our customers expect us to have a fatality prevention program and a means of assuring critical controls are in place. When BHP, Rio Tinto, and Newmont talk to us about safety, it’s always about what we are doing regarding our critical controls. It’s important to us to be a tier 1 company, which is what we aspire to be!_

**Senior Safety Advisor, Metso**

> _As an operational leader at one of the world’s largest mining companies, I relied on Forwood’s Critical Risk Management (CRM) system daily. Their CRM system was instrumental in ensuring my team understood the critical risks they faced and how to effectively control them. It allowed me to capture and evaluate the effectiveness of these controls, providing my leaders with the confidence that our safety management system was being utilized as intended. Forwood’s CRM system is incredibly user-friendly and straightforward to teach, making it an indispensable tool for any safety-conscious organisation._

**Superintendent, Global Mining Company**

> _As a consultant specialising in high performance leadership, psychological safety and front-line safety management, I have the privilege of working closely with Forwood and their clients. My passion for Forwood’s Critical Risk Management (CRM) system remains as strong as it was when I was an end user in one of the world’s largest mining companies. The CRM system is incredibly effective in helping teams understand and control critical risks, ensuring the critical controls are in place and effective before the work starts. Its user-friendly design makes it easy to teach and integrate into any organisation. I have seen firsthand how Forwood’s CRM system enhances safety management, providing leaders with the confidence that their teams are well-supported and protected._

**David Watson, Director of NeuroLead (Channel Partner)**

> _CRM+ is bringing a lot of improvements, eliminating a lot of unnecessary paper and really focussing on what poses a risk for us. You focus directly on the problem and the resolution is immediate, without postponing the problem._

**Brazilian Mine Operator**

**COO, TIER 1 US MINING COMPANY**

> _When you implement CRM+, it makes a huge difference to your fatality prevention program. It breaks down barriers with language and the culture. When everyone is doing the same thing, the fatality prevention program becomes far more effective._

**VP EHS & RISK, TIER 1 MINING COMPANY**

> _When you implement CRM+, it makes a huge difference to your fatality prevention program. It breaks down barriers with language and the culture. When everyone is doing the same thing, the fatality prevention program becomes far more effective._

**What is the Critical Risk Visibility Gap?**

The Critical Risk Visibility Gap is the disconnect between the information leadership receives and operational reality – leaving workers exposed to fatal risk. In this executive guide, we explain what causes the Critical Risk Visibility Gap, how it increases the risk of serious injuries and fatalities (SIFs), and why Critical Risk Management is the effective method for making fatal risk visible. [Download Now](https://forwoodsafety.com/resources/guides-reports/closing-the-critical-risk-visibility-gap/)
